applicable_failures: The agent's own filename-regex screen (lpa|limited|partnership|fund|side|key|claw|agreement...) is the stated basis for choosing which matters to read next. Its output is only 101 lines for 117 candidates, so at least 16 candidates had no matching files and dropped out. Filenames such as 1001-00002's carried-interest and LPAC papers do not prove key-person or clawback terms.

The 62 matters flagged as appearing in searches with no folder listed (e.g., 1001-00003, 1005-00001, 1021-00001) may not be inside the 117 candidates. The agent never reconciled the candidate list against them, so qualifying matters could be missing from the listing.

The 62 unlisted matters from earlier searches were not checked against candidates.txt. The first screening call also failed with a syntax error and was rerun, so the 101-line output is the only filter evidence.
critique.recommendation: Check that every matter in the unlisted-search set is in candidates.txt; list any that are missing. Then rank candidates by content evidence from earlier scans (key-person and clawback hits), not by filename. Open the governing LPA of every candidate that has hits, and give a reason for each exclusion.
